the development of a multiplex PCR that will allow the simultaneous detection of HRSV and HMPV.
the development of a cost-effective multiplex RT- PCR for the simultaneous detection of HMPV and two subtypes of HRSV.
the development of a rapid, sensitive, specific, cost-effective, multiplex RT- PCR for simultaneous detection of HRSVA, HRSVB and HMPV from respiratory specimens.
